verdict.rationale: The Core Ultra 7 258V is a mobile/ultra-low-power (Lunar Lake V-series) processor designed for thin-and-light laptops, evidenced by repeated references to 'unplugged and on-the-go' battery-life and mobile use cases; such parts are soldered (BGA) rather than socketed, so a desktop-style multi-generation socket upgrade path is a category mismatch, not a missing documentation item.
